title: RSNA Knee report-labeler assets
subtitle: prompt_template.py (v2_fewshot) + metrics.py + validation_58.csv
description: report-labeler benchmark assets. Source: workspace/expA00_report_labeler_validation/. prompt_template.py = v2_fewshot judging rules (single source of truth shared with the Claude Opus 5 baseline run), validation_58.csv = 58 gold-labeled studies extracted from train.csv, metrics.py = shared evaluation code identical to the one used for the Claude Opus 5 baseline (macro F1 0.733).
